outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar-style diagram showing single percentage values (illumination overhead) for each exposure-time condition, not an average across replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B is a set of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a set of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a line plot showing mean±s.e.m. photobleaching decay curves; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel E consists of representative micrographs (including a color-coded intensity heatmap of the same images), not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Panel F is a scatter plot with a fitted mean curve and shaded s.e.m., and individual data points (color-coded by cell) are explicitly displayed.
Panel G is a scatter plot with a fitted mean curve and shaded s.e.m., and individual data points (color-coded by cell) are explicitly displayed.
Panel H is a scatter plot with a fitted mean curve and shaded s.e.m., and individual data points (color-coded by cell) are explicitly displayed.
Panel I is a set of representative dual-color micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel J is a line plot showing normalized mean intensity with shaded s.e.m. across frame number; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
